# Sharkings Interiors & Exteriors

> Leading Interior Design Firm & Modular Kitchen Specialist with Flagship Experience Centres in Madurai & Ramanathapuram (Ramnad), serving South Tamil Nadu and all of Tamil Nadu since 2010.

## Overview
Sharkings Interiors & Exteriors is a premier, full-service residential and commercial interior design studio, modular kitchen manufacturer, and turnkey execution contractor. Our primary flagship ateliers are located in Madurai and Ramanathapuram, with extensive turnkey execution across South Tamil Nadu (Sivagangai, Virudhunagar, Theni, Dindigul, Tirunelveli, Thoothukudi, Tenkasi, Kanyakumari) and statewide throughout Tamil Nadu.

## Key Facts
- **Founded**: 2010 (Over 15+ years of design and manufacturing excellence)
- **Specializations**: Turnkey Residential Interiors, Custom Waterproof Modular Kitchens, Commercial Spaces, Exterior ACP Elevation, Modular Wardrobes, Shipping Container Architecture.
- **Experience Centres**:
  - **Madurai Atelier (Flagship)**: Plot No. 3552, TNHB Colony, Villapuram, Madurai, Tamil Nadu 625001.
  - **Ramanathapuram Centre**: Bus Stop, 13/2993/26, Madurai - Rameswaram Hwy, Subbaiah Nagar, Ram Nagar, Ramanathapuram, Tamil Nadu 623501.
- **Primary Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 80980 90204
- **Email**: sharkingsindia@gmail.com
- **Official Website**: https://www.sharkingsinteriors.in

## Primary Services
- **Modular Kitchen Design**: Acrylic, Laminate, PVC, and Marine Plywood waterproof modular kitchens (L-shape, U-shape, Parallel, Island, Straight).
- **Home Interiors**: Complete living room hall designs, TV cabinets, false ceilings with LED profile lighting, master bedroom interior suites.
- **Modular Wardrobes**: Sliding wardrobes, lacquered glass wardrobes, walk-in closets, hinged doors.
- **Commercial & Office Design**: Retail stores, beauty salons, spas, corporate offices, glass partitions, reception areas.
- **Exterior ACP Elevation**: Front elevation designs, ACP sheet cladding, HPL panels, exterior louvers, glass facades.
- **Container Architecture**: Custom shipping container homes, container cafes, modular office spaces.

## Geographical Service Tiers
1. **Tier 1 (Primary Hubs)**: Madurai District (Villapuram, Anna Nagar, KK Nagar, SS Colony, Bypass Road, Kalavasal, Tallakulam, Pudur, Sellur, Goripalayam, Melur, Tirumangalam, Usilampatti) & Ramanathapuram District (Ramnad, Rameswaram, Paramakudi, Kilakarai, Devipattinam, Mudukulathur, Kamuthi, Sayalgudi, Mandapam).
2. **Tier 2 (South Tamil Nadu Coverage)**: Sivagangai, Karaikudi, Virudhunagar, Aruppukottai, Sivakasi, Rajapalayam, Theni, Dindigul, Tirunelveli, Thoothukudi, Tenkasi, Kanyakumari.
3. **Tier 3 (Statewide Tamil Nadu)**: Turnkey villa interiors, factory-made modular kitchen shipments, and commercial project installations across all districts of Tamil Nadu.
